title: Mujadara
author: farag4m

step.title: Saute onions
step.text: Using Saute mode, cook the sliced onions in 3 tbsp olive oil until deep golden brown. Remove and set aside.

step.title: Cook lentils
step.text: Add the lentils, 1.5 cups water, 1/2 tsp salt, and cumin. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes, then quick release.

step.title: Add rice
step.text: Add the rinsed rice, 3 cups water, remaining salt, black pepper if using, and a drizzle of olive oil. Stir once.

step.title: Final cook
step.text: Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.

step.title: Add onions and serve
step.text: Fluff the rice and lentils. Mix most of the browned onions into the Mujadara, then top with the remaining onions and serve warm.

notes: Pressure-cooker-only recipe. Use the pressure cooker's Saute mode for the onions.
